value.rationale: A clique plus one deficient vertex has a perfect matching for every m>=1; the kinetic process nevertheless fails with probability tending to e^-c at m~cn/log n. This resolves the natural exact transition from almost-sure jamming defect to reliable completion. A single-vertex boundary controls full matching while bulk matched density always tends to one, so it is a substantive microscopic vs macroscopic distinction.
